author: Shevaun Coker
text: Yeah, my husband has had 3 in a row that stopped working after a week with a "replace sensor" error - but I can scan them on my phone and it gives me a reading. Very frustrating.

author: Craig Jordison
text: Now and then with the error message but it's easy to get around by turning off your device for a couple of minutes and turn it on and it clears the error and keeps everything working as well even when you get the error message
